newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers says bets on Scotland match void.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers says bets on Scotland match void.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill said bets laid on Scotland's World Cup match against Estonia were void.
Scotland were awarded a 3-0 victory in their European group four qualifier in Tallinn after their Estonian opponents failed to turn up for the match after it was rescheduled.
"Our rules clearly state that if a game is abandoned before 90 minutes play takes place then all bets are void," the company said in a statement.
The company had quoted Scotland as 1-5 to win the match, with the draw at 9-2 and Estonia at 8-1.
